A household's reserved wood-floor seat (and its re-seat) asked of the exact families where the region reads taken

decisions.summary: static_clear asks hard/local/lane in turn wherever the region reads taken, for EVERY candidate (jittered grid, gap fill, settle seats), not only reserved seats
decisions.why: FR-004/US3: each candidate read against the region, not tested against each keep-out in turn. R16's failure is confined to reserved seats (_seat(reserved=True) and its re-seat); the grid candidates' only change was a sixth fewer crowns, a map move the GM allowed. 'The one fix is the prefilter form' stretches one case's argument over unlike cases: the reserved-seat fix is local and was not built. Build regions-alone with the exact families asked for reserved seats only, gate and measure it; withdraw only on that measurement.
